name: check_extension_eligibility
description: check_extension_eligibility: Verify whether a license is eligible for extension. Returns eligible: true and the expiration date on success. Blocks if the license already has a pending extension, is under investigation, has already expired, or expires more than 60 days from now.

state_license_number.description: The state license number. Format: STATE-TYPE-NUMBER. Example: MA-RN-004821
